column1: # Inventory map for plan task 15, the replacement closeout (ruling CX-A).
# Two record kinds, tab-separated; lines starting with '#' and blank lines are
# ignored. Read by docs/probes/closeout-inventory-check.sh against a live run of
#   F <TAB> family <TAB> class <TAB> probe <TAB> arm <TAB> test <TAB> divergences <TAB> rulings <TAB> behaviour
#   M <TAB> target <TAB> file <TAB> owner-ERE <TAB> name-ERE <TAB> decl-ERE <TAB> family
# class: A SwiftUI-aligned (probe file + arm id in it + a test that resolves in
# Tests/), D documented divergence (live labels in docs/divergences.md), M
# MetalUI-only by design (rulings), X deprecated (the declaration carries
# absences) are not census rows; they live in docs/divergences.md and record
# §66 §1.3. `-` is an empty cell. A family's divergence column lists the
# labels it carries beside its class.
# M rows are matched in order; the first row whose target, file (path under
# Sources/<target>/), owner, name and declaration text all match claims the
# census row. Target, file, owner and name are EREs anchored as ^(…)$; decl-ERE
# is searched in the declaration's signature (the line the census points at
# joined with the following lines up to the one opening its body).
# Owners are the census's dotted enclosing type ('-' at file scope).

column9: the host: one App, windows driven by a display link, a headless renderFrame; SwiftUI's App/Scene lifecycle is not offered
Element/ElementGroup/StyledElement/ProposalElement/ProposalElementGroup: gpui's three-phase requestLayout/prepaint/paint protocols in place of View
LayoutPass/PrepaintPass/PaintPass phase objects; isHovered/isActive/isFocused paint-only (PhaseSeparationTests)
LayoutPass's requestNative*/markNativeGrid* registrars: the kernel's primary API for a custom element
@ViewBuilder's shapes: one structural slot per if/for, content an evaluated conditional removes is reset on return, if/else/switch in every container
AnyView: @State/@Environment bind inside an AnyElement
.id(_:) on every element group; a changed name resets, a departed name starts fresh on return; two same-named siblings share one identity (72)
GlobalElementID/PathComponent: the structural identity path value (positional/named components, -1 for an overlay)

Component/StyledComponent: layout-transparent, identity-opaque composition; .width/.height frame each member; .frame is one layer over a row of per-member frames, the members aligned by the frame's own alignment where SwiftUI's Group uses the parent's (56)
Deferred: a portal hoisting to the root layer; absolute content is a presentation root against the window
Handlers/HitboxID/KeyHandler: handler storage and hitbox ids
@State per occurrence, dispatch-resolved; an optional with a non-nil default reads it before its first write (85 retired); a write from outside dispatch reaches the last-bound occurrence (71)
Binding<Value>: SwiftUI's surface (get/set, constant, dynamic member, optional initialisers, animation/transaction), @MainActor (78)
@Environment/EnvironmentValues/EnvironmentKey/.environment/.transformEnvironment/.disabled: nearest writer wins, a transform composes, a modifier after a scope is outside it

displayScale/pixelLength, controlActiveState, controlSize, accessibilityReduceMotion: platform-stamped, scope-writable (reduce motion get-only); controlSize reaches only text and Button chrome (76); layout rounds to points (77)
dynamicTypeSize is carried and changes no built-in text size, as SwiftUI on macOS
layoutDirection is carried and readable; no container mirrors (25)
locale is carried and window-stamped; MetalUI has no formatter or tokenizer that reads it (record §05)
Theme/ColorToken/.theme: scoped, paint-only theme tokens
@FocusState/.focused: read the window's focus, move it from input; focus leaves with its identity; a click does not focus a .focusable() (94)

column9: HStack/VStack/ZStack/Spacer/alignments/.layoutPriority: SwiftUI's stack algorithms, typed alignment, text baselines
ProposalFrame/.frame on proposal content: fixed and flexible frames, ideal on an unspecified axis; a negative fixed size traps (38)
nativeFrame(...): an undeprecated alias of .frame, kept because deprecating it breaks the 0-warning baseline (record §09)
Padding/.padding on proposal content: insets the proposal, places the child at its own size
Background/.background(token) on proposal content: fills the box it is written on, beneath its content
FixedSize/.fixedSize: withholds the selected axes from the child's proposal
Color: a greedy fill answering its proposal
.aspectRatio/.scaledToFit/.scaledToFill/ContentMode; nil ratio uses the child's own
.border on proposal content: a square band over whatever it is written after
.opacity on either vocabulary: what is written after it escapes it; a second opacity replaces the first (46)
.allowsHitTesting: gates the pointer target; per layer (44); default region the whole frame (41); a disabled target passes the click (23)
.contentShape(inset:)/.contentShape(Shape): moves the pointer region only
ModifiedContent<Content, Modifier>/LayoutModifier/ModifierLayerKind: one flat modifier chain, one layer per modifier, SwiftUI's ModifiedContent
ModifierLayer, the ModifiedElement typealias, _wrap: the legacy arm of ModifiedContent; a layer added at run time is adopted by the new outermost (20)
OverlayModifier/.overlay: the overlay at the primary's size under child -1; a multi-member primary traps (73)
BackgroundModifier/.background(alignment:content:): the overlay's recipe, painted first; a non-clickable primary passes a click to it (57)
ProposalScrollView/ScrollAxis/ScrollIndicatorVisibility: scroll axes, indicators (.visible as .automatic, .never as .hidden)
ScrollViewReader/ScrollViewProxy.scrollTo: one slot, reach its own subtree, keys by value
UnitPoint: scrollTo anchors and grid cell anchors
ProposalText: text in the proposal vocabulary; answers min(proposal, widest line)
ProposalLayout/ProposalLayoutContainer/subview proxies/ProposedSize: SwiftUI's Layout without a cache
Grid/GridRow/cell modifiers: SwiftUI's Grid (reference model; residual disagreements 61, 62)
ForEach: identity by key, a dropped element resets; description-colliding ids keep the first (79)
Transaction/withTransaction/.transaction/.animation(_:value:): a transaction stack; one root transaction per build (99)
AnyTransition/Edge/.transition: the documented set; no default transition (98)
Animation curves and withAnimation: modifier wrappers animate at their phase; interpolation of declared input, not placed geometry (96); what snaps (97)

Native… typealiases and native… modifiers: use the un-prefixed name (HStack, VStack, ZStack, ProposalFrame, Padding, Background, FixedSize, Spacer, Rectangle, Color, LayoutModifier, ModifiedContent, OverlayModifier, OnTapModifier; .padding/.fixedSize/.background/.clip/.border/.opacity/.allowsHitTesting/.overlay/.onTap)
HStack/VStack init(spacing:alignment:content:): use init(alignment:spacing:content:)
Rectangle(color:): use Rectangle().fill(_:) (Rectangle(width:height:color:) stays, the fixed leaf convenience)
.frame() with no arguments: a deprecated no-op; delete the call
Box: the legacy (CSS-derived) container, lowered onto the kernel; public init(decoration:), the style: initialisers package (CX-D)

Decoration/BorderStyle and the legacy background/hoverBackground/focusBackground/cornerRadius/border/hoverBorder/focusBorder: paint-only decoration on one order-insensitive record; corner radius rounds fill and border without clipping (47); a rounded border follows the arc (49)
Row/Column/Stack/Alignment/legacy ScrollView/ScrollState/ScrollContext: the legacy containers, lowered; Row/Column gap 0 (52); legacy ScrollView's cross axis from its parent (54)
Style/Position/FlexDirection/AlignItems/AlignSelf/JustifyContent: opaque outside the package
List: virtualized, data-driven, uniform rows; selection; windows against its own origin

margin/gap/justifyContent/alignItems/flexGrow/flexShrink/flexBasis(length)/alignSelf/position/inset/flexDirection: CSS item and container fields lowered onto the kernel, unlowerable cases refused by name
StyledElement.padding: one wrapper layer; chained padding accumulates; a padded click target is hittable in its padding (42)
ElementGroup.frame(...): SwiftUI's frame surface on legacy content, lowered onto the kernel frame (ideal and flexible maxima answer as SwiftUI; 35 and 39 retired by CX-G)
StyledElement.clipped/.clipShape: clip the subtree and its hitboxes
.hidden(): keeps its space, paints nothing, takes no hit, is not published, leaves the keyboard's focus half
onKey/focusable/onAction/keyContext: gpui's raw key and action handlers and focusability (21, 22, 26, 94)
onClick (and proposal onTap/OnTapModifier): Button semantics (press and release on one element), pressable through accessibility (27)
focusBorder/focusBackground: the opt-in focus ring and focus fill
Button/ButtonRole/ButtonStyle/.keyboardShortcut on a Button: actions, roles (ButtonRole binds a key, draws nothing), styles, pressed look
Toggle/Slider/Stepper on Binding: values, steps, clamping, keys once focused (80); the partial accessibility fold (82)
Picker/PickerStyle/.tag/TaggedElement: options found through tags; automatic is segmented, not a menu (81)
Text (legacy-vocabulary leaf): measured and drawn through the text seam; fonts, line limits, truncation; width not ceiled to the pixel grid (60); line advance (86); middle truncation (87)
Text.proposalLayout(): converts a legacy Text to a ProposalText, dropping background, handlers, id and hover/focus colours
Font, Font.Weight, Font.Design, Font.TextStyle: system sizes/weights/designs, the eleven text styles, custom families
.font/.fontWeight/.italic/.foregroundStyle/.foregroundColor/.lineLimit/.truncationMode/.multilineTextAlignment, TextAlignment, Text.TruncationMode
TextField/TextEditor controlled initialisers, submit, undo, paging: MetalUI's own text-input surface

TextField(_:text:)/TextEditor(_:text:) over Binding<String>, forwarding to the controlled initialisers; MetalUI-only evidence: no probe arm exercises TextField(text:)/TextEditor(text:) (data-and-scrolling's B4 is a Binding built outside any view), so the forwarding is pinned by aTextFieldBoundToStateUpdatesItOnEveryEdit alone; the Binding surface itself is the binding family's (B4/B5)
Shape/ShapeGeometry/Rectangle/RoundedRectangle/Circle/Capsule/Ellipse/ShapeView/.fill/.stroke/.strokeBorder; continuous corners drawn circular (90)
.clipShape/.clipped/.cornerRadius/.clip on proposal content: one clip layer; an ellipse clip traps (91); crossing rounded clips square (92)
.background(_:in:)/.background(in:): a filled shape behind the content
Image/Image.Interpolation: decorative and labelled images, .resizable, .interpolation (.high draws bilinear, 93)
ImageBitmap: the portable stand-in for CGImage (premultiplied RGBA8)
Gesture/TapGesture/LongPressGesture/DragGesture/composition and .gesture/.simultaneousGesture/.highPriorityGesture/.onTapGesture/.onLongPressGesture: one arena per press
KeyEquivalent/KeyboardShortcut/EventModifiers: exact, case-folded matching in tree order
Keymap/KeyBinding/Keystroke/KeymapBuilder/KeyContext/ContextPredicate/Action/ActionHandler: gpui's keymap and actions

accessibility modifiers on both vocabularies, AccessibilityModifier/Traits/ChildBehavior/Adjustment: .ignore/.combine/.contain, hidden, hint, identifier, traits, declared and named actions, modal isolation (95)
AXNode/AXRole/AXTrait: the neutral accessibility record a StyledElement declares; a List publishes realised rows only (32)
AXActionKind/AXNode.actions/AXNode.init(…actions:…): use accessibilityAction(_:)/accessibilityAdjustableAction(_:)
width/height/minWidth/minHeight/maxWidth/maxHeight and width/height(fraction:)/(percent:): use .frame (LR-ES recipe R1–R8)
flexBasis(fraction:)/flexBasis(percent:): no SwiftUI counterpart; declare a length or a .frame
MetalUICore geometry and units (Point, Size, Bounds, Edges, Corners, Axes, Pixels, Rems, Length, Dimension, …)
Hsla/Rgba: colours authored in sRGB, composited in a Display P3 layer (1)
Appearance: the host's light/dark appearance, selecting the theme
ControlActiveState: key/active/inactive, SwiftUI's cases; the platform mapping is MetalUI's own (C1–C3 unmeasured)
LayoutDirection: carried, read by no container (25)
MetalUILayout's LayoutTree, node ids, registrars, measure functions, grid marks, spacing, rounding (77)
MetalUIPlatform: Platform/PlatformWindow/WindowRenderer, input events, the neutral accessibility tree
MetalUIRender/MetalUIPrimitives/MetalUIAppKit: the Metal renderer, surfaces, shader library, the AppKit platform
MetalUIScene: Scene, draw runs, the glyph atlas, FontKey, GlyphImage, ImageTexture
MetalUIText/MetalUITextSystem: the TextSystem seam and its CoreText conformer
